objective: One complete Classic cycle: comparison league, public failure review, priority candidate, plan-selection candidate, context-preserving desktop teacher and compact student experiment, then acceptance audit.
scope: Classic Normal; historical Hard is an optional reference, not a new variant or difficulty project
development_gate: Freeze a candidate for independent strength testing when its predecessor score is at least 52% and focused tests reveal no new tactical failure. Development scores alone never support adoption.
adoption_gate: Fresh predecessor paired-bootstrap 95% score interval entirely above 50%; fresh matched league difference interval entirely above zero; unchanged cooperation/tactical and hidden-information tests; real native/X16 parity, timing, bank/stack, saves and distribution checks for any adopted runtime change.
teacher_gate: Assess fresh predecessor and league evidence, plus public-input invariance and persistence of strategic context. A failed teacher remains a rejected experiment; any student fit using it is diagnostic and cannot be adopted on that teacher evidence alone.
data_rules: Training uses development games only, balanced across families/phases/armies with paired source games kept in the same split. Final validation seeds and games are quarantined. Retain full and cold-history examples.
cycle_limit: One initial priority design, one plan-selection design, one context-preserving teacher design and one new compact student fit. Record rejections rather than launch an unbounded parameter search. Production may remain unchanged if no candidate earns adoption.
